environment.image_identity: record immutable image digest, WhaleCode commit, model identifier, provider endpoint family and tool profile in every run
environment.api_key_source: .env.local DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; never copy the value into artifacts or logs
environment.concurrency: parallelize repeats across isolated containers; serialize arms within each paired repeat unless the provider returns an explicit rate-limit-free capacity reservation

samples.held_out_rule: Do not inspect candidate outcomes on held_out_formal before the FLA-8 decision run. Environment validation may execute fixtures without a model and may not score candidate behavior.
samples.directory_hash_rule: From the repository root, sort all repository-relative file paths under the scenario directory bytewise, concatenate sha256sum lines in that order, then sha256 the resulting UTF-8 LF manifest. Prompt, fixture and validator bytes are therefore frozen together.

arms.baseline_identity: The frozen baseline is commit 48922ce9b plus the exact environment and provider identities recorded by the run manifest.
arms.candidate_identity: One FLA phase commit or one FLA-6 experiment commit. Unrelated changes are forbidden.

smoke.claim_limit: Smoke may detect regressions but may not establish benefit or non-regression.

formal.randomization: Choose and record one seed before any candidate run. The seed determines sample order; arm order uses the applicable cycle by paired repeat index modulo cycle length.
formal.stopping_rule: Run all 30 complete paired repeats per sample. Do not inspect candidate aggregate gates or stop early. Evaluate once after the matrix is sealed; an interval crossing a threshold is inconclusive and does not promote.
formal.confidence: two-sided 95% paired bootstrap confidence interval with 10000 resamples, stratified by sample ID
formal.multiple_candidates: Holm-Bonferroni correction across candidates tested against the same frozen baseline within one FLA decision family

hard_gates.rule: candidate failures <= frozen-baseline failures and candidate success rate >= frozen-baseline success rate

non_inferiority_gates.threshold: candidate increase <= 10% versus paired frozen baseline

metric_definitions.provider_request_count: Count provider HTTP attempts excluding exact transport retries; report retries separately.
metric_definitions.total_input_tokens: Sum provider-reported prompt/input tokens for all non-retry provider requests.
metric_definitions.cached_input_tokens: Sum provider-reported prompt cache hit tokens. Missing telemetry is unavailable, never zero.
metric_definitions.uncached_input_tokens: total_input_tokens minus cached_input_tokens only when both values are provider-reported for the request.
metric_definitions.request_2_plus_cache_hit_rate: sum cached_input_tokens from non-retry requests ordinal >=2 divided by sum total_input_tokens from those requests.
metric_definitions.combined_control_plus_next_rate: eligible lifecycle control calls with their required real sibling in the same assistant response divided by all eligible calls.
metric_definitions.wall_time: monotonic elapsed time from first provider send to terminal scenario verdict; environment setup excluded.
metric_definitions.monetary_cost: Disabled unless a separate immutable price artifact pins model input, cache-hit input, output and reasoning prices. Missing price is unavailable, never inferred.

attribution_rules: Environment, auth and provider-capacity failures invalidate the pair and are rerun with the same pair ID; they are not model successes or failures.
Agent-generated invalid arguments, protocol violations, ordinary tool mistakes and wrong task outputs remain scored behavioral failures.
A trace missing token, cache, request or contract fields is trace_incomplete and cannot support a performance claim.
No run may be deleted as an outlier after outcomes are visible. Exclusions must match the taxonomy and remain in the raw manifest.
required_artifacts: run-manifest.json with sample, pair, arm order, seed, commits, image digest, model and provider identities
requests.jsonl with one record per provider request and transport retry
tool-events.jsonl with ordered call/result envelopes and TaskSpace revisions
map-events.jsonl with canonical event hashes and projection emissions
summary.csv containing per-run and aggregate totals, means, medians, p95 and cache rates
paired-bootstrap.json containing confidence intervals and stopping decision

promotion_decision.promote: All hard gates pass and all corrected confidence bounds satisfy every non-inferiority threshold.
promotion_decision.reject: Any hard gate fails or a non-inferiority confidence bound is entirely outside its threshold after 30 repeats.
promotion_decision.inconclusive: Required telemetry is unavailable or a confidence interval crosses a threshold after 30 repeats; do not promote.
promotion_decision.benefit_claim: A positive benefit may be claimed only for a preregistered superiority metric whose corrected 95% interval excludes zero. Passing non-inferiority is not a benefit claim.
